Matchup: SF is about league-average against RBs.

Keeping it honest: on their own, recent games (form) say 58% and the matchup 62%. The sportsbooks are usually close to right, and these methods have only partly beaten them (weights measured on NFL week 2), so we pull them most of the way toward the market: form 57%, matchup 57%.
